compiled_state.title: [ci-llm-review-runner]: Deep-tier opus reviewer produces findings without cited_lines despite schema instructions
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description
The deep-tier opus code-reviewer-deep-arch agent produces reviewer-findings.json findings that omit the cited_lines field, despite all 10 agent files being rebuilt (T6 of epic 6da2-4cff) with explicit cited_lines schema instructions.

Observed in E2E validation run (story 69ac-a647): 7 findings produced, all missing cited_lines.

The validate-review-output.sh gate (T7) correctly catches this at commit time, so the guard is in place. But the LLM model is not following the instruction to include cited_lines.

## Reproduction
Run ci-llm-review-runner.sh against any large PR diff and inspect reviewer-findings.json — all findings omit cited_lines.

## Expected
Each finding includes cited_lines with at least one entry in <path>:<line> format.

## Actual
findings[*].cited_lines is absent in all outputs from the deep-arch synthesis pass.
